ns2:section.sectionText: This course is restricted to Economics Majors. Read more about Economics Course Restrictions and Overrides: http://www.economics.illinois.edu/undergrad/resources/current/ This course covers topics regarding immigration to developed countries, focusing on the U.S. Topics include: a brief history of U.S. immigration policy; models of migration; labor market, demographic, and fiscal impacts of immigration; geographic preference and ethnic enclaves; and outcomes for immigrants by generational status (assimilation) and race/ ethnic group. Course requirements include an in-class presentation and a paper.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
